steps.title: Clean Build Script Dependencies
steps.description: Purge non-standard external dependencies from build.gradle to ensure 100% Android SDK native compliance.

steps.title: Configure 3D Coordinate and Matrix Math Engine
steps.description: Implement pure Java 3D vector transformations, rotation matrices (Yaw/Pitch), perspective projection, and Lambertian lighting calculations.

steps.title: Implement 3D Cube and Polygon Depth Sorter
steps.description: Create 3D polyhedral face structures with normal vectors, back-face culling, and Painter's algorithm depth sorting.

steps.title: Upgrade Tetromino Piece Architecture
steps.description: Assign distinct vibrant 3D color themes and matrix topologies to each tetromino shape.

steps.title: Upgrade Brick Game Logic Engine
steps.description: Add 3D color metadata to placed blocks, ghost piece destination calculation, and 3D line clear events.

steps.title: Create High-Performance 3D Game Viewport
steps.description: Build GameView3D with 3D glass cage, illuminated 3D tetrominoes, real-time touch camera orbital rotation, 3D ghost projection, and line explosion particles.

steps.title: Update 3D Color Palettes and Styling
steps.description: Define rich 3D shading tones, neon accents, dark arcade background colors, and control button drawables.

steps.title: Refactor Layout for 3D Arcade Gameplay
steps.description: Integrate 3D viewport, camera perspective switchers, floating HUD overlay, and responsive arcade controls.

steps.title: Refine Audio Synthesis Engine
steps.description: Safely manage 8-bit sound tones for rotations, movement, 3D drops, and multi-line clearances.

steps.title: Integrate 3D Camera Controls and Activity Lifecycle
steps.description: Connect interactive 3D rotation, camera preset toggles, high score persistence, and continuous touch controls in MainActivity.

steps.title: Building Brick Game Classic
steps.description: Compile debug APK using Gradle build tools.
